adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff shows `user_id = params.require(:user_id).to_i` followed by `group.users.delete(user_id)` and then returning `success_json` if `group.save` succeeds. Ruby's `to_i` will coerce non-numeric strings (e.g. "abc") to `0`, and deleting `user_id=0` will be a no-op (no matching row) yet `group.save` will still typically succeed, causing the endpoint to report success despite invalid input. The diff contains no validation that `user_id` is a valid integer > 0 or that the user was actually removed.
